title: Tourism Demand Forecasting
thesis: Snowflake forecasts tourist arrivals by source market 90 days ahead, detects demand anomalies, and powers Snowflake Intelligence for tourism planning — replacing disconnected forecasting tools with unified ML-native analytics

talking_points: Thailand on track for 35 million arrivals this year — 90-day forecast shows 12% growth vs last year.
Chinese market recovering at 67% of 2019 levels. Indian market exceeding 2019 by 140%.
Phuket capacity constraint: forecast shows 95% hotel utilization during peak season.
tabs.call_out: 35M arrivals forecast — Phuket approaching capacity constraint

transition.line: Let's drill into which markets are driving growth.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST generates 90-day predictions for 100 market-destination pairs.
Indian market: 28% above forecast — visa-free policy driving unexpected surge.
European market: seasonality decomposition shows 3-week earlier peak than last year.
show: Show forecast charts by top 5 markets
Click India for detail with confidence bands
tabs.call_out: 100 forecasts updated daily — India surging 28% above model

transition.line: What leading indicators explain these patterns?

talking_points: Composite leading indicator combines flight capacity, visa applications, and search trends.
Flight capacity from India up 45% — 3 new routes announced for Q1.
Search trends for 'Chiang Mai temple' up 200% in Korean market — Cortex Analyst shows correlation.
show: Click India to expand flight + visa data
tabs.call_out: Leading indicators predict demand 60-90 days ahead

transition.line: Now let the CSO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Dr. Arunee asks: 'Where should we allocate Q1 marketing budget across markets?'
Cortex Analyst: Based on forecast ROI — India (40%), China (25%), Korea (15%), Europe (20%).
Switch to advisor: 'What's the risk to our China forecast?' — analyzes macro factors and policy changes.
show: Type: 'Optimal Q1 marketing budget allocation by market'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL forecasting + strategic advisory via Snowflake Intelligence

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
ML.FORECAST replaces SageMaker custom models; Snowflake Intelligence replaces QuickSight Q.
Thailand's tourism: ฿2.4T annual contribution. This forecasts for 20 markets × 5 destinations.
tabs.call_out: Native ML forecasting — no external model training needed

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Thailand tourism planning.
